hiveSql:
SELECT  object_id,
                                s_info_windcode,
                                n_info_stockid,
                                n_info_companyid,
                                ann_dt,
                                n_info_title,
                                n_info_fcode,
                                n_info_ftxt,
                                n_info_annlink,
                                opdate,
                                opmode,
                                bath_dt,
                                data_ins_time,
                                task_rs_id
							FROM ${srcdbname}.w_ashareanninf 
                            where ann_dt between from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(cast(${beg_date} as string), 'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd')
							             and from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(cast(${end_date} as string), 'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd')

preSql:
delete from wd_ashareanninf WHERE (ann_dt< (to_date(to_char(${end_date}),'yyyyMMdd') -365 )) 
                        or (ann_dt BETWEEN to_date(to_char(${beg_date}),'yyyyMMdd') AND to_date(to_char(${end_date}),'yyyyMMdd') )
